pages.about: Broadleaf Supply Co. is an online retailer serving customers across the country. We keep our margins tight and pass the difference on. Our range is chosen for value and turnover rather than breadth, and we restock weekly.
pages.refund_policy: Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a refund. Opened consumables cannot be returned unless faulty or incorrectly supplied. Refunds issued within 5 business days.
pages.shipping_policy: Standard shipping $5.99, free over $50, delivered in 2-4 business days. Orders placed before 1pm ship the same business day.
pages.subscription_terms: Subscribe and save 10% on any repeat item. Deliveries every 30, 60 or 90 days. Cancel or skip at any time from your account with no minimum term.
